# Will Apple Podcasts accept your feed?

> Paste your podcast RSS feed to check it against Apple Podcasts requirements and the RSS 2.0 spec: missing tags, bad pubDates, duplicate guids. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/podcast-feed-check/)

- [Why podcast feeds fail validation](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/podcast-feed-check/why-podcast-feeds-fail-validation.html)
